name: @remult/sv
description: sv add-on for remult: a full-stack, type-safe SvelteKit app in one command
author: Jean-Yves Couët

scripts.demo-create: rimraf demo && sv create demo --types ts --template minimal --no-add-ons --no-install
scripts.demo-add: npm run build && sv add tailwindcss=plugins:none paraglide=languageTags:en,fr+demo:false vitest=usages:unit ai-tools=ide:claude-code+delivery:tools+tools:mcp,svelte-code-writer,svelte-core-bestpractices,svelte-file-editor+mcpSetup:remote file:../ --cwd demo --no-git-check --no-download-check --no-install
scripts.demo-add:full: npm run build && sv add tailwindcss=plugins:none paraglide=languageTags:en,fr+demo:false vitest=usages:unit ai-tools=ide:claude-code+delivery:tools+tools:mcp,svelte-code-writer,svelte-core-bestpractices,svelte-file-editor+mcpSetup:remote file:../=preset:full --cwd demo --no-git-check --no-download-check --no-install
